name: POKE Keyboard Ring Buffer
description: Reads keyboard scancodes from kernel ring buffer. Kernel stores every keypress at a known BSS address. Rebuild kernel to update addresses (i686-elf-nm kernel.elf | grep kb_).

KB_WRITE_IDX.desc: Write index (number of keys pressed since boot)

KB_RING.desc: Ring buffer base (256 bytes of scancodes)

operations.name: read_keycount
operations.desc: Read total number of keypresses since boot
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0x0002a3e0
mov eax, [eax]
ret

operations.name: read_lastkey
operations.desc: Read scancode of most recently pressed key (30=A, 31=S, 32=D, etc.)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov ecx, 0x0002a3e0
mov ecx, [ecx]
dec ecx
and ecx, 255
add ecx, 0x0002a2e0
movzx eax, byte [ecx]
ret
operations.returns: Last scancode in EAX (PS/2 scancode, e.g. 30=A, 48=B, 46=C)
